verdict.rationale: Pipedream has a dedicated AI-frameworks docs page with Vercel AI SDK integration code that auto-loads tools (`mcpClient.tools()`) and a reference chat app built on the AI SDK. The developer docs also list integrations with popular AI frameworks and LLMs, including a native MCP connector through Claude's Messages API and streamlined MCP integration with automatic tool execution. Missing for 10: documented LangChain and CrewAI adapters, explicit attribution of an OpenAI SDK integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
